facts.text: C3000SyringePump is the PyLabware class for the Tricontinent C3000 syringe pump with integrated valve, based on the operation manual 8694-12 E

The DT-protocol command prefix is '/' plus the switch address; the terminator is the autorun command PRG_RUN plus CRLF, the reply prefix is '/0', the reply terminator is ETX CRLF and arguments are not separated
is_connected queries the firmware version and returns False only on a connection error
is_initialized reads the initialized status and returns False on a connection error
is_idle reads the status byte and returns False when bit 5 reports busy or an error is present
The absolute-position query is the '?' command (GET_SYR_POS)
get_plunger_position sends the absolute-position query and returns an integer
The valve-position query is '?6' (GET_VALVE_POS) and its reply is upper-cased
get_valve_position sends the valve-position query
move_home is move_plunger_absolute(0)
move_plunger_absolute sends the absolute move command and waits until the pump is idle
move_plunger_relative converts its argument with int(), withdraws when it is positive and dispenses its absolute value otherwise
dispense sends the relative dispense command (SYR_SPIT_REL)
withdraw sends the relative aspiration command (SYR_SUCK_REL)
The valve-position strings are built from I, O, B and E with the numbered I1..I6 and O1..O6 forms; VALVE_POSITIONS holds the bare digits and the empty IOBE argument
set_valve_position picks the command from the first character (I, O, B or E) and sends the rest as the argument
SET_MAX_VEL checks a maximum velocity of 1 to 48000 increments per second
set_speed sends SET_MAX_VEL
SET_START_VEL checks a starting velocity of 1 to 8000
set_start_velocity sends SET_START_VEL
SET_STOP_VEL checks a cut-off velocity of 1 to 21600
set_stop_velocity sends SET_STOP_VEL
SPEED_MODES is keyed by the speed codes 0 to 40
SET_MAX_VEL_CODE checks its argument against the SPEED_MODES keys
set_predefined_speed sends SET_MAX_VEL_CODE
RAMP_PLOPE_MODES is keyed by the ramp codes 1 to 20
SET_RAMP_PLOPE checks its argument against the RAMP_PLOPE_MODES keys
set_ramp_slope sends SET_RAMP_PLOPE
RESOLUTION_MODES is keyed by N0, N1 and N2
SET_RES_MODE checks its argument against the RESOLUTION_MODES keys
set_resolution_mode sends SET_RES_MODE
The usage guide calls the relative amounts units and shows withdraw(200) leaving position 200 and dispense(200) returning it to 0
PRG_TERM is the terminate command 'T'
stop sends PRG_TERM, which terminates command execution immediately
get_speed raises NotImplementedError, so the configured speed cannot be read back
